feat: Update dependencies and enhance USB transfer functionality with improved file handling and user experience

- Updated Android dependencies in build.gradle.kts for better performance and compatibility.
- Added lint baseline configuration to manage lint warnings effectively.
- Refactored SharedPreferences usage to use SharedPreferencesAsync for improved async handling across various services.
- Enhanced USB transfer process with better file transfer UX, including directory selection and improved error handling.
- Updated software detail screen to use a fullscreen dialog for the USB transfer wizard, improving user interaction.
- Improved notification service and offline storage service to ensure consistent async operations.

feat: Enhance USB transfer functionality and permissions handling

- Updated USB transfer notifier to include new state properties for delete confirmation and files to delete.
- Added new providers for managing delete confirmation and files to delete.
- Implemented confirmation dialog for file deletion in the USB transfer wizard.
- Improved permissions intro screen to handle storage and notification permissions with user feedback.
- Updated dependencies in pubspec.yaml for file_picker package.
feat: Enhance USB transfer process with improved permission handling, user confirmation for file deletion, and dynamic progress updates

feat: Enhance USB transfer functionality with new UX features

- Added fields to UsbTransferState for tracking cancellation status, cancellability, estimated time remaining, files to delete, and delete confirmation needs.
- Introduced new providers for enhanced UX: isCancelled, isCancellable, estimatedTimeRemaining, filesToDelete, needsDeleteConfirmation, and timeRemainingFormatted.
- Updated transferStatusInfo provider to include new fields for better UI representation.
- Improved error handling and user feedback during the USB transfer process.
- Documented the USB transfer process flow and key features in usb.txt.
feat: Update app version to 0.5.270 and enhance USB transfer completion UI with dynamic status messages and ZIP extraction details
refactor: Remove OfflineIndicator widget from main app structure
feat: Add ConnectionStatusIcon widget to display connectivity and sync status in the dashboard

feat: Implement enhanced offline storage and synchronization features

- Added OfflineStorageTestExample to demonstrate new querying capabilities for documents, software, and machines.
- Introduced SyncService to manage background synchronization with Firebase services, including document, software, and machine syncing.
- Created OfflineIndicator widget to provide real-time connectivity and sync status feedback to users.
- Enhanced error handling and user notifications for offline capabilities and sync processes.
feat: implement machine management with Firebase integration and display filtering

Refactor software providers to use AsyncValue and update document and software states to handle undefined values. Enhance document and software repository screens by integrating a comprehensive filter bottom sheet and improving search functionality. Introduce MachineState to manage machine data effectively.
feat: add auto-download functionality for documents and software with notification support
refactor: update Software model to use uploadDate instead of releaseDate and adjust related components
refactor: remove 'View All Documents' button from DashboardScreen

Refactor: Remove PreferencesProvider and SoftwareProvider

- Deleted PreferencesProvider and SoftwareProvider classes to streamline the codebase.
- Removed associated methods for loading and saving preferences and software.
- Updated DashboardScreen to integrate recent uploads from documents and software.
- Enhanced document and software handling in DashboardScreen with new loading and download functionalities.
- Updated navigation to use GoRouter for better routing management.
- Improved UI components for displaying recent uploads and handling downloads.
fix: remove unnecessary READ_PHONE_STATE permission from AndroidManifest.xml and update version in pubspec.yaml

feat: Refactor PreferencesScreen to use notification service for managing notifications

- Changed PreferencesScreen from ConsumerWidget to ConsumerStatefulWidget.
- Integrated notification service to handle enabling/disabling notifications.
- Added FutureBuilder to check notification status and update UI accordingly.
- Updated notification preferences for document updates and software updates.
- Improved state management by using setState for UI updates.

feat: Enhance SoftwareDetailScreen to load software by ID

- Added named constructor to SoftwareDetailScreen for loading software by ID.
- Implemented loading state while fetching software details.
- Updated references to software providers for better clarity.

fix: Update permissions handling in PermissionsService

- Replaced debugPrint with logger service for error handling in permissions requests.

refactor: Centralize image loading with ImageService

- Created ImageService to handle loading and caching of images.
- Updated MaintenanceTab, PartsDiagramTab, and ResultCard to use ImageService for image loading.

chore: Update dependencies in pubspec.yaml

- Updated pdfx dependency to use a specific Git repository.
- Added firebase_messaging and flutter_local_notifications dependencies.
- Updated go_router to a newer version.
- Updated custom_lint to the latest version.

feat: Implement notification service for handling FCM notifications

- Created NotificationService to manage Firebase Cloud Messaging.
- Added methods for subscribing/unsubscribing to notification topics.
- Implemented local notifications for foreground messages.
- Integrated logging for notification events and errors.
- Added methods to enable/disable notifications based on user preferences.

style: Add notification icons for Android

- Added XML drawable for notification icon.
- Added color resource for notification icon color.

Refactor preferences management: remove favorite machine and filter functionality

- Removed toggleFavoriteMachine and toggleFavoriteFilter methods from PreferencesNotifier.
- Updated isMachineFavorite and isFilterFavorite providers to directly access user preferences.
- Eliminated favorite machines and filters sections from DashboardScreen and PreferencesScreen.
- Refactored MachineDetailScreen to load machine data based on machineId instead of passing a Machine object.
- Cleaned up MachineListScreen by removing favorite icon and related logic.
- Updated pubspec.yaml to remove unused assets.
- Added basic widget test for counter functionality.
fix: resolve 'Ref' class undefined errors by removing deprecated typedefs and updating imports across providers

feat: add FilterRecommendation model with JSON serialization and copy functionality

- Introduced FilterRecommendation class to encapsulate filter recommendation data.
- Added fields: tempHardness, totalHardness, cpd, filterType, filterSize, bypass, capacity, and createdAt.
- Implemented copyWith method for creating modified instances.
- Added toJson and fromJson methods for easy serialization and deserialization.
- Overridden equality and hashCode for proper comparison and usage in collections.

Fix riverpod providers and notifiers: Resolve 'Ref' class undefined errors by adding explicit 'Ref' typedef in provider files and usb_transfer_notifier.dart, and update type annotations in riverpod providers.
Fixed some issues with riverpod

feat: add PermissionsService to manage app permissions and requests

- Implemented PermissionsService to handle permission checks and requests.
- Added methods to check if the user has seen the permissions intro and if permissions have been requested.
- Included logic to request storage and notification permissions, as well as manage external storage on Android 11+.
- Integrated SharedPreferences for storing user preferences regarding permissions.

Add Software Repository Screen and Firebase Software Service

- Implemented SoftwareRepositoryScreen for displaying and managing software packages.
- Added search and filter functionality for software based on machine and category.
- Integrated FirebaseSoftwareService for fetching software data from Firestore and downloading files from Firebase Storage.
- Enhanced user experience with progress indicators for downloads and filter chips for active selections.
- Included error handling and user prompts for software downloads.

Enhance document handling in document_viewer_screen.dart and TechnicalDocument model by adding download URL support, error handling for non-downloaded documents, and refactoring machine ID to support multiple associations.
Improve sign-out flow in preferences_screen.dart by capturing router before async operations
